*Data as of 2026-11-17. All prices in USD per GPU-hour unless noted.*

| Signal | Detail |

| **NVDA stock** | $154.40 (−18.2% YTD), trading near 52-wk low of $148.80 |
| **AMD stock** | $501.43 (+124.4% YTD), well above 52-wk low of $188.22 |
| **Geopolitical risk** | US tightening remote-access controls; Nvidia capping Chinese customers at 49% of data-center business |
| **Supply signal** | A ~10,000-GPU A100 cluster (~$60 M) listed on eBay — large-scale A100 decommissioning underway |
| **New entrants** | SambaNova SN50 inference racks; SpaceX "Kessel" 72× Rubin rack-scale system |

**Bottom line:** The market is in a transition window. A100s are being retired in bulk, H100/H200 supply is tightening into Q4, and Blackwell (B200/B300/GB200) is ramping. AMD's MI300X/MI325X are gaining real traction as a cost alternative.

---

## 2. Reserved vs. Spot / On-Demand: Decision Framework

### When to **commit to reserved / 1-yr contracts**

| Condition | Rationale |
|-----------|-----------|
| **Steady-state training workloads > 6 months** | Reserved rates typically run 30–50 % below on-demand. At H100-SXM on-demand avg of **$5.82/hr** (Q4-26), a reserved deal at ~$3.00–3.50/hr saves **$200 K+ per 8-GPU node per year**. |
| **Prediction-market spike ahead** | The H200 market-implied curve shows **$6.65 → $7.13/hr** for Nov–Dec 2026, then a cliff to **$1.75–2.00/hr** by Feb 2027. If your workload spans Q4-26 into Q1-27, a 6-month reserved lock at today's ~$3.00/hr avoids the Dec spike. Same logic for H100-SXM (implied $3.21 → $3.65 in Q4-26/Q1-27 vs. $2.13 from Feb 2027). |
| **Multi-node / NVLink-domain workloads** | Providers (CoreWeave, Crusoe, Lambda) discount 8-GPU HGX nodes 15–25 % vs. single-GPU on-demand. You can't get that on spot. |
| **Compliance / data-residency requirements** | Reserved capacity in a specific region (e.g., Oracle OCI, Azure) is the only way to guarantee in-region placement. |

### When to **use spot / on-demand**

| Condition | Rationale |
|-----------|-----------|
| **Burst / batch inference, fine-tuning runs < 2 weeks** | Spot pricing on H100-SXM can dip to **$1.99/hr** (Together AI) vs. $5.82 on-demand avg — a **66 % discount**. Even at the 25th-percentile floor of $1.79, you save >50 %. |
| **A100-80GB workloads (decommissioning tail)** | Vast.ai lists A100-80GB at **$1.15/hr** (on-demand) with spot lows historically hitting $0.38. With 10 K-GPU A100 clusters hitting the secondary market, expect further price erosion through 2027. No reason to reserve. |
| **Experimental / R&D workloads** | RTX-4090 at **$0.45/hr** (Vast.ai) or L4 at **$0.43/hr** gives you a GPU for less than a coffee. Spot interruption risk is acceptable. |
| **GB200 / B300 early-adopter testing** | GB200 on-demand avg has *fallen* from $19.51 (Q2-26) to **$15.73** (Q4-26), with Vast.ai at **$9.38/hr**. The quarterly trend is downward. Wait for spot; don't lock a 1-yr contract on a GPU that's still stabilizing in price. |

### Quick decision rule

```
If (workload_duration > 3 months) AND (GPU in {H100, H200, B200, B300})
    → Reserve 6-12 mo, target 30-40% below on-demand avg
If (workload_duration < 2 weeks) OR (GPU in {A100, L4, T4, RTX-4090})
    → Spot / on-demand, set auto-terminate on interruption
If (GPU in {GB200, B300}) AND (workload is experimental)
    → On-demand now, re-evaluate in 60-90 days as prices settle
```
